title: What Lunar Farm Modules Is

t: 2030 — First module hulls products reach price parity: hydroponic racks
title: 2030 — First module hulls products reach price parity: hydroponic racks
definition: 2030 milestone on the Lunar Farm Modules roadmap.
description:
First module hulls products reach price parity: hydroponic racks cultivation at commercial scale.

What must be true first: the hydroponic racks results have to replicate outside the lab, module logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and water loops operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed hydroponic racks demonstrations, module logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting water loops uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Lunar Farm Modules
definition: Estimates Lunar Farm Modules readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Lunar Farm Modules components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a module hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where hydroponic racks monitoring, module logistics redundancy, or water loops maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Lunar Farm Modules Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Lunar Farm Modules: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Lunar Farm Modules — farm modules for the Moon.

Phase 1 — Prove (hydroponic racks): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (module logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (water loops): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (radiation shielding): module hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and Moon-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
